source_name: 55_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__055_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_047_text_description.md
text_description: A cream and vivid red resort-like ensemble shown from upper torso to mid-leg, built in soft, relaxed layers: an open, hip-length cream cardigan or lightweight jacket sits over a matching collared knit top, with the outer layer edged and patterned in bold red horizontal bands, red shoulder patches, narrow black outlines, and small gold-tone buttons along the front edge. The inner top has an open polo-style collar and a deep V neckline, with a large abstract red geometric panel rising diagonally from the waist across the front, creating a strong graphic contrast against the pale base. The proportions are loose and fluid rather than close-cut, with the top layers falling over pale cream wide-leg trousers that gather into fine vertical pleats from the waistband and drape softly downward. Styling is accessorized with a chunky gold statement necklace resembling layered shells or leaves around the neck, dangling earrings, and a large textured cream tote carried on the shoulder, finished with black straps, black edge binding, and a dark curved appliqué on the side. The overall palette is warm cream, saturated red, black accents, and gold jewelry, giving the look a polished nautical-resort or graphic knitwear mood.
